title: American public opinion on AI
description: Long-running poll questions on how the US public feels about AI, from the two organisations that have asked the same thing repeatedly.
notes: Hand-entered from published releases — no pollster offers a machine-readable feed — with every figure's citation recorded alongside it in manual/us-ai-opinion.csv. The lines come from different surveys with different question wording and sampling, so read the movement within a line and not the gaps between them. Each question is asked about once a year.
